text: Bitcoin's modest gains paired with Ethereum's flat performance suggest caution despite the extreme greed reading; risk appetite is present but not translating into broad altcoin strength. BTC dominance at 58.9% indicates investors are concentrating holdings in the largest asset rather than rotating into alternatives, which typically signals uncertainty about the broader market. The Fear & Greed spike to 78 with $126B in daily volume shows sentiment has shifted sharply bullish over the week, but the divergence between BTC's upside and ETH's stagnation warrants watching whether this is conviction or momentum-driven.
